name: sandbox-bot-solo
description: The shipped sandbox level with the baseline loadout: one 1x take opens the gate, clears both grunts and the turret while dodging its bolt (bot inputs, recorded open-loop).

level.name: Sandbox
level.tagline: A scrap room to try everything.

objective.text: Take out both grunts and the turret

briefing: Sandbox. Everything is unlocked here: every speed, every end mode, all four cassettes.
The lever opens the door north. The cracked wall south breaks to a hard enough hit.
The laser splits the far room while nobody stands on the plate.

hints.1: Try 2x on the cracked wall: the same heavy swing carries twice the momentum.
hints.2: Park a self on the plate and the laser drops for everyone else.

notes: Objective complete at beat 6.93: Take out both grunts and the turret.
